name: null
description: The null value: tag 0, no payload.

name: bool_false
description: false: tag 1.

name: bool_true
description: true: tag 2.

name: int_0
description: The integer 0: tag 3, then its zigzag form 0 as a varint.

name: int_1
description: The integer 1: tag 3, then its zigzag form 2 as a varint.

name: int_minus_1
description: The integer -1: tag 3, then its zigzag form 1 as a varint.

name: int_63
description: The integer 63: tag 3, then its zigzag form 126 as a varint.

name: int_64
description: The integer 64: tag 3, then its zigzag form 128 as a varint.

name: int_minus_64
description: The integer -64: tag 3, then its zigzag form 127 as a varint.

name: int_minus_65
description: The integer -65: tag 3, then its zigzag form 129 as a varint.

name: int_8191
description: The integer 8191: tag 3, then its zigzag form 16382 as a varint.

name: int_8192
description: The integer 8192: tag 3, then its zigzag form 16384 as a varint.

name: int_2147483647
description: The integer 2147483647: tag 3, then its zigzag form 4294967294 as a varint.

name: int_2147483648
description: The integer 2147483648: tag 3, then its zigzag form 4294967296 as a varint.

name: int_9223372036854775807
description: The integer 9223372036854775807: tag 3, then its zigzag form 18446744073709551614 as a varint.

name: int_minus_9223372036854775808
description: The integer -9223372036854775808: tag 3, then its zigzag form 18446744073709551615 as a varint.

name: float_zero
description: A float, positive zero: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_minus_zero
description: A float, negative zero: its sign bit is kept in every form: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_one
description: A float, one, spelled 1.0 so the text reads back as a float: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_minus_one_and_a_half
description: A float, a negative float: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_tenth
description: A float, 0.1, the shortest text that reads back as the same f64: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_half
description: A float, exactly an f32, still written as a full f64 (tag 4) in a plain value: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_ten_to_the_16
description: A float, text spells it 1e16, never 10000000000000000 (that reads as an int): tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_max
description: A float, the largest finite f64: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_min_positive
description: A float, the smallest normal f64: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_subnormal
description: A float, the smallest subnormal f64: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_small
description: A float, a small exponent: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_f32_max
description: A float, the largest f32, as an f64: tag 4, then the f64 as 8 bytes little-endian.

name: float_infinity
description: Positive infinity. Binary only: the text form writes a non-finite float as null (a different value), so no text is given. The binary form keeps the exact 64 bits, a NaN's payload and sign included; compare floats by their bits.

name: float_minus_infinity
description: Negative infinity. Binary only: the text form writes a non-finite float as null (a different value), so no text is given. The binary form keeps the exact 64 bits, a NaN's payload and sign included; compare floats by their bits.

name: float_nan
description: The quiet NaN. Binary only: the text form writes a non-finite float as null (a different value), so no text is given. The binary form keeps the exact 64 bits, a NaN's payload and sign included; compare floats by their bits.

name: float_nan_payload
description: A NaN with a payload. Binary only: the text form writes a non-finite float as null (a different value), so no text is given. The binary form keeps the exact 64 bits, a NaN's payload and sign included; compare floats by their bits.

name: float_nan_negative
description: A NaN with the sign bit set. Binary only: the text form writes a non-finite float as null (a different value), so no text is given. The binary form keeps the exact 64 bits, a NaN's payload and sign included; compare floats by their bits.

name: str_empty
description: The empty string: a new table entry of length 0.

name: str_ascii
description: A short ASCII string: tag 5, a new-string marker (length << 1 | 1), the bytes.

name: str_latin
description: Accented letters: UTF-8, the length counts bytes (13), not characters.

name: str_cjk
description: Three characters, nine bytes.

name: str_emoji
description: Characters outside the BMP: four bytes each in UTF-8.

name: str_escapes
description: Text escapes these; binary holds them raw.

name: str_control
description: Control characters: text writes them as \u00xx.

name: str_separators
description: Not escaped in text, kept raw.

name: str_at_doubled
description: A string as spelled: a plain text that starts with `@` is stored with it doubled.

name: str_looks_like_ref
description: A string spelled like a reference is still a string value in the model; only a schema reads it as a ref.

name: str_looks_like_bytes
description: A string spelled like bytes is still a string value in the model.

name: str_len_63
description: 63 bytes: the marker 127 is the last one-byte varint.

name: str_len_64
description: 64 bytes: the marker 129 takes two bytes.

name: text_exponent_is_float
description: An exponent makes a float, even a whole one (the `E` may be upper case).

name: text_exponent_two
description: 1e2 is the float 100.0, not the int 100.

name: text_int_past_i64
description: A whole number that does not fit i64 reads as a float.

name: text_int_past_u64
description: Likewise far past u64.

name: text_float_overflows
description: A float too big for f64 reads as infinity (and writes back as null).

name: text_minus_zero_int
description: `-0` without a fraction is the int 0.

name: text_int_min
description: i64::MIN reads as an int.

name: bytes_empty
description: No bytes: tag 9, length 0. Text: `@bytes:`.

name: bytes_small
description: Four bytes: tag 9, a varint length, the raw bytes. Text is base64 with padding.

name: bytes_every_value
description: Every byte value 0..=255: the length 256 is a two-byte varint.

name: ref_file
description: A reference: tag 8, then its kind and id as table strings. Text: `@kind:id`.

name: ref_user
description: A reference to a user.

name: ref_colon_in_id
description: An id may hold colons; only the first colon splits kind from id.

name: ref_unicode_id
description: An id is any text without whitespace or control characters.

name: ref_kind_digits
description: A kind is `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`.

name: ref_at_in_id
description: An id may start with `@`.

name: list_empty
description: An empty list: tag 6, count 0.

name: list_mixed
description: Values of every plain type in one list.

name: list_nested
description: Lists in lists.

name: list_of_ints
description: A plain list of ints: a value built as a model value is written with tag 6 and a tag per item (a typed writer may pack it, see the packed cases).

name: list_of_refs
description: References in a list share the table: kind `file` is written once.

name: map_empty
description: An empty map: tag 7, count 0.

name: map_file_order
description: Keys keep the order they were written in; they are never sorted.

name: map_nested
description: A map of a user: strings, a list, a map, a ref and bytes.

name: map_unicode_key
description: Keys are strings like any other.

name: map_empty_key
description: The empty string is a key.

name: map_at_key
description: A key starting with `@` is only a key, never a typed value.

name: table_repeated_values
description: A string repeated is written once; later uses are the table index shifted left (an even varint).

name: table_repeated_keys
description: Map keys are table strings too: `id` and `name` cost one varint after their first map.

name: table_key_is_value
description: A key and a value that are the same string share one table entry.

name: table_empty_string
description: The empty string takes a table entry, and is referred to by it.

name: table_kinds_and_ids
description: A reference's kind and id are table strings: the id `a` of a doc reuses the file's `a`.

name: table_two_byte_index
description: Table index 64 needs a two-byte varint (64 << 1 = 128).

name: ints_packed_empty
description: A list of ints packed: tag 10, a count, then a zigzag varint per item with no tag each. Decodes to the same list as tag 6 would.

name: ints_packed_small
description: A list of ints packed: tag 10, a count, then a zigzag varint per item with no tag each. Decodes to the same list as tag 6 would.

name: ints_packed_varints
description: A list of ints packed: tag 10, a count, then a zigzag varint per item with no tag each. Decodes to the same list as tag 6 would.

name: ints_packed_extremes
description: A list of ints packed: tag 10, a count, then a zigzag varint per item with no tag each. Decodes to the same list as tag 6 would.

name: float32_single
description: A float that is an f32: tag 12, four bytes little-endian. Decodes to the f64 of the same value.

name: floats_packed_narrow
description: A writer picks tag 14 (f32 each) when every f64 survives the round trip through f32 bit for bit; -0.0 does.

name: floats_packed_wide
description: Tag 13 (f64 each) when any one does not: 0.1 is not an f32.

name: floats_packed_mixed
description: One value that is not an f32 widens the whole list, 0.5 included.

name: floats_packed_empty
description: An empty list of floats picks the narrow tag 14.

name: floats32_packed
description: A list of f32s: tag 14 always, 4 bytes each.

name: floats_packed_non_finite
description: Binary only (text writes null for them): a quiet NaN and infinity survive f32 bit for bit, so the narrow tag 14 is used.

name: stream_empty
description: An empty stream: tag 11, a u32 byte length (here 1), then the count 0.

name: stream_own_table
description: A stream has its own string table: `audit` is written again inside it although the document already has it, and `opened` is written once inside.

name: stream_ints
description: Stream items are values: six ints, each tag 3 and a zigzag varint.

name: syntax_comments
description: Line and block comments are whitespace.

name: syntax_trailing_commas
description: A trailing comma is allowed in a list and in a map.

name: syntax_unquoted_keys
description: A key may be written without quotes.

name: syntax_bom
description: A leading byte order mark is skipped.

name: syntax_whitespace
description: Spaces, tabs and line breaks between tokens are free.

name: syntax_typed_strings_stay_strings
description: The text parser keeps a typed spelling as the string it is; a schema (or the binary form) gives it its type.

name: syntax_escapes
description: The JSON escapes, including `\/` and `\b`, `\f`.

name: syntax_surrogate_pair
description: A `\u` surrogate pair is one character.

name: syntax_raw_unicode
description: Non-ASCII characters may be written as they are.

name: frame_scalars
description: A record: its byte length, then the fields in declaration order: a bool byte, zigzag varints for ints, f32 and f64 raw little-endian, a string as its table index.

name: frame_scalars_extremes
description: Extremes: i32::MIN, i64::MAX as an unsigned number, -0.0 as an f32, an empty string.

name: frame_options_present
description: An Option is a byte 0 or 1, then the value when there is one.

name: frame_options_absent
description: A missing Option is only the byte 0.

name: frame_bytes
description: Bytes: a varint length, then them raw; the string next to them is a table index.

name: frame_strings_shared
description: Strings go in a table after the body, each once, in the order first used; the body holds table indexes. A repeated string is the same index.

name: frame_strings_empty_and_unicode
description: The empty string is a table entry; the table holds raw UTF-8.

name: frame_table_length_two_bytes
description: A 130-byte string makes the table longer than 127 bytes: its length (131 with its own length byte) is a two-byte varint written backwards at the frame's end.

name: frame_links
description: An `Id<User>` packs as its id's own type (a u64: one varint) with the kind implied by the field; an `Id<Doc>` as a table string; a `Ref` of any kind as two table strings, kind and id.

description: A user id of 300 takes a two-byte varint.

description: A list of records: a count, the list's byte length, then each record with its own length; a unit enum is its variant index as a varint.

name: frame_samples
description: Lists of numbers: f32s raw (4 bytes each); f64s with a flag byte, 1 when every one is an f32 exactly (4 bytes each) else 0 (8 bytes); ints bit-packed with a count and a width byte, signed ones zigzagged first.

name: frame_samples_empty
description: Empty lists: a count 0; an empty f64 list has the flag 1; an empty int list has width 1.

name: frame_record_length_two_bytes
description: A record longer than 127 bytes has a two-byte varint length.

name: frame_record_appended_fields
description: Fields are only ever appended. A frame packed with `owner` and `archived` is read by a schema that knows only `name` and `files`: the record's length lets it skip the rest.

name: frame_record_older_frame
description: A frame packed before the fields were appended, read by a newer schema: the missing trailing fields are left out of the value read by shape, and take their defaults when the schema says `default` (owner none, archived false).

name: frame_root_uint
description: A frame whose root is a number: the varint, then an empty table (length 0).

name: frame_root_text
description: A frame whose root is a string: the table index 0, then the table holding the string.

name: frame_root_text_at
description: A frame holds a string raw; reading it by shape gives the model's spelling, a leading `@` doubled.

name: frame_ints_w1_n255
description: 255 unsigned ints of 1 bits: count, the width byte, then no full group: numbers one after another.

name: frame_ints_w1_n256
description: 256 unsigned ints of 1 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w1_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 1 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w7_n255
description: 255 unsigned ints of 7 bits: count, the width byte, then no full group: numbers one after another.

name: frame_ints_w7_n256
description: 256 unsigned ints of 7 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w7_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 7 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w8_n255
description: 255 unsigned ints of 8 bits: count, the width byte, then no full group: numbers one after another.

name: frame_ints_w8_n256
description: 256 unsigned ints of 8 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w8_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 8 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w13_n255
description: 255 unsigned ints of 13 bits: count, the width byte, then no full group: numbers one after another.

name: frame_ints_w13_n256
description: 256 unsigned ints of 13 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w13_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 13 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w32_n3
description: 3 unsigned ints of 32 bits: count, the width byte, then no full group: numbers one after another.

name: frame_ints_w32_n256
description: 256 unsigned ints of 32 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w32_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 32 bits: count, the width byte, then a full group in lanes, then the rest one by one.

name: frame_ints_w33_n5
description: 5 unsigned ints of 33 bits: wider than 32 bits never use lanes, the numbers follow one another.

name: frame_ints_w33_n257
description: 257 unsigned ints of 33 bits: wider than 32 bits never use lanes, the numbers follow one another.

name: frame_ints_w48_n5
description: 5 unsigned ints of 48 bits: wider than 32 bits never use lanes, the numbers follow one another.

name: frame_ints_w63_n5
description: 5 unsigned ints of 63 bits: wider than 32 bits never use lanes, the numbers follow one another.

name: frame_ints_empty
description: No ints: count 0, width 1, no bytes.

name: frame_ints_one
description: One int: count 1, width 1.

name: frame_ints_signed
description: Signed ints are zigzagged before they are packed (-1 is 1, 1 is 2, -3 is 5, 70000 is 140000), and the width is that of the biggest.

name: io_two_messages
description: Each message is a little-endian u32 length, then that many bytes (here a binary document). The stream ends cleanly after a whole frame, where a read of the next length finds no byte.

name: io_no_messages
description: An empty stream ends cleanly at once: no error, no frame.

name: io_empty_frame
description: A frame may be zero bytes long; it is still a frame, and the stream goes on.

name: io_long_message
description: A 300-byte message: the length is 0x0000012c, four bytes always (never a varint).

name: text_empty

name: text_only_whitespace
description: Whitespace only.

name: text_duplicate_key

name: text_unclosed_list

name: text_extra_closer

name: text_two_values

name: text_unclosed_string

name: text_single_quotes
description: Strings use double quotes.

name: text_raw_newline
description: A line break inside a string must be written `\n`.

name: text_raw_tab

name: text_unknown_escape

name: text_lone_surrogate

name: text_hex_number

name: text_line_and_column

name: text_too_deep

name: schema_type_mismatch

name: schema_bare_id

name: binary_short_magic
